answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit and build verifiable work history before its votes count fully. A sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund every identity, so cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. New identities start with limited trust, like a seedling on the tundra, and only gain weight as their record proves reliability. A zephyr of free signups cannot flood the system, because influence flows through staked, attested history rather than raw headcount, keeping the wider ocean of participants honest.
